heading: Donald M. Payne International Development Fellowship Program

tree.heading: Authorization
tree.text: There shall be in the Department a Donald M. Payne International Development Fellowship Program.

tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: The program required by subsection (a) shall continue to provide financial assistance, mentoring, and professional development opportunities to individuals pursuing careers in international development.

tree.heading: Administration
tree.text: The program required by subsection (a) shall be administered by the Department, consistent with existing law and regulations.

notes.heading: Definition
notes.text: For definition of “Department” as used in this section, see section 5002 of Pub. L. 119–60, set out as a note under section 2651 of this title.
